title: Self-Control
definition: Self-control is Spirit-produced restraint over desires, words, habits, and actions in submission to God.
summary: Believers are not called to be ruled by impulses, appetites, anger, or temptation. The Spirit trains them in godly discipline.
christFocus: Christ frees His people from slavery to sin and teaches them to live under His lordship.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Believers are not called to be ruled by impulses, appetites, anger, or temptation. The Spirit trains them in godly discipline.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
